tools.name: search_gear
tools.description: Search the Gearlist catalog of source-checked AI agent tools, MCP servers and skills. Matches words in the name, category, description, audience and access notes, best match first. Each result includes its access notes, which you should show the human. Entries are documentation-checked only, not ins

tools.name: get_gear
tools.description: Get one Gearlist entry by its id, as returned by search_gear, with what was checked and when. Entries are documentation-checked only. Nothing was installed or audited.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the Gearlist categories with the number of entries in each.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the agent skills published in the Gearlist repository, with the command that installs each one. Ask the human before running any install command.

tools.name: recommend_stack
tools.description: Find a short set of Gearlist entries whose own text shares the most words with a job you describe, spread across groups, quoting where each match appears. Matches are on words, so check each entry suits the job before suggesting it.
